Google search results as JSON: web, news, images, places, shopping, scholar and patents.

## API key

**Unverified:** nobody has checked this against Serper's own docs yet. [Tell us](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Fix%20provider%20docs%3A%20) if something is wrong.

1. Open [serper.dev](https://serper.dev/api-keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from serper.dev (2,500 free queries to start).

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add serper
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  serper: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Serper's [API](https://serper.dev/playground) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show serper` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Prepaid credits, one per successful query: $1.00 per 1k on the 50k pack, down to $0.30 per 1k on the largest.

**Rate limits:** 50 calls a second. Starter credits 50 queries per second; Standard 100, Scale 200, Ultimate 300.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Serper).
